parameters.query:
-- Todo lo que pinta el panel, en UNA consulta.
--
-- Una sola ida y vuelta en vez de siete: el panel se abre entero o no se abre,
-- y no hay forma de que una tarjeta muestre datos de un momento y la de al
-- lado de otro.
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'generado_at', NOW(),

  'embudo', (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(embudo, n), '{}'::jsonb)
    FROM (SELECT COALESCE(embudo,'sin_segmentar') AS embudo, count(*) AS n
          FROM leads GROUP BY 1) t
  ),

  'secuencia', (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(paso::text, n), '{}'::jsonb)
    FROM (SELECT secuencia_paso AS paso, count(*) AS n
          FROM leads WHERE secuencia_proximo_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) t
  ),

  -- Respuestas y bajas: lo que mide si la secuencia molesta o funciona.
  'reacciones', jsonb_build_object(
    'contestaron',  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE replied_at IS NOT NULL),
    'bajas',        (SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE unsubscribed_at IS NOT NULL),
    'no_respuesta', (SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE email_status = 'no_respuesta'),
    'clientes',     (SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE pagado_at IS NOT NULL)
  ),

  -- A/B de las guias. La columna que importa es `pagaron`, no los clics: saber
  -- que variante gusta no sirve de nada si no se sabe cual vende.
  'ab_guias', (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
             'variante', variante, 'leads', leads, 'pagaron', pagaron)), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM (SELECT variante_guia AS variante, count(*) AS leads,
                 count(*) FILTER (WHERE pagado_at IS NOT NULL) AS pagaron
          FROM leads WHERE variante_guia IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) t
  ),

  'ingresos', jsonb_build_object(
    'total_eur', COALESCE((SELECT sum(importe_cent) FROM stripe_eventos), 0) / 100.0,
    'mes_eur',   COALESCE((SELECT sum(importe_cent) FROM stripe_eventos
                           WHERE recibido_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW())), 0) / 100.0,
    'por_producto', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(producto, n), '{}'::jsonb)
      FROM (SELECT producto, count(*) AS n FROM leads
            WHERE pagado_at IS NOT NULL AND producto IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) t
    )
  ),

  'whatsapp', (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(estado, n), '{}'::jsonb)
    FROM (SELECT estado, count(*) AS n FROM tareas_whatsapp GROUP BY 1) t
  ),

  'idiomas', (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(idioma, n), '{}'::jsonb)
    FROM (SELECT COALESCE(idioma_comunicacion,'sin_idioma') AS idioma, count(*) AS n
          FROM leads GROUP BY 1) t
  )
) AS panel;
